summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reprinted a Boston Globe history of American pugilists abroad, which listed Tom Allen among nineteen champions of the American prize ring.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Saturday, January 7, 1888, page 8. Article by T. P. Evans in the Boston Globe.

facts.fact: A Boston Globe history listed Tom Allen among the nineteen champions of the American prize ring, between Aaron Jones and Ned O'Baldwin
The article said Bob Smith, the colored fighter, won decisive victories over Tom and Harry Allen; it is unclear whether this Tom Allen is the St. Louis champion

notes: The 'Tom and Harry Allen' beaten by Bob Smith may be different fighters (Bob Smith fought in England in the 1860s); check before using.
